notes.title: Quick Fix - Sept 26
notes.content:
Another day, another quick fix!  This update is for Windows, Mac, and Linux.

Thank you to MoolyChaos and Marceline for finding this one.

- Fixed: Rare race condition where the Blood timer disappears after beating the Alien mini game

Thanks,
ForwardXP

notes.title: Minor Update - Windows / Mac / Linux
notes.content:
Hey Friends!

We’re happy that so many of you came to hang out with us at the office, and none of you messed with our machines (right?).

A round of fixes for Windows and Mac (Thank you all who reported bugs, and feature suggestions).

As well as an update for the Linux build that brings it up to date with all other versions. 

Changes :
[list]
[*] Asynchronous achievements - now pop when you get them
[*] Changed the way things save slightly (switch related)
[*] Fixed a bug related to the save changes
[*] Properly recording button presses to save
[*] Perfectionist achievement fixed
[/list]

Thanks again to you all, and our friends at Four Quarters (Have you played Loop Hero?)

-ForwardXP

notes.title: Please, Don't Touch Anything 2025 Refresh Update
notes.content: [h1]Please, Don't Touch Anything 2025 Refresh Update[/h1][p]Wow! It's been 9 years since the last update to Please, Don't Touch Anything on Steam. There's an entire generation of gamers who haven't taken a turn at solving the fiendishly mind-bending puzzles, and we wanted to take a moment to update the classic game to ensure it runs great on current Windows and Mac systems.[/p][p]We've also taken the opportunity to move to the current version of GameMaker, and clean up some bugs that have been bothering us for.. well.. years.[/p][p]This refresh update will also make it easier to push new updates in the future. We've got a few ideas...[/p][p][/p][h2]General Changes & Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Updated to latest version of GameMaker[/p][/*][*][p]Updated to latest Steamworks SDK and API[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various missing art elements across the game[/p][/*][*][p]Added missing animation frame in Bender Ending[/p][/*][*][p]Updated deprecated effects used in some endings to use more modern effects[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where game would snap back to first monitor when using dual monitors[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed custom cursor missing issues[/p][/*][*][p]Pressed the red button (Sorry...)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Platform-Specific Changes[/h2][h3]Windows[/h3][list][*][p]Updated to support Windows 10 & 11 [/p][/*][/list][h3]MacOS[/h3][list][*][p]Updated to support MacOS 10.14+[/p][/*][*][p]Game updated to run on modern Apple Silicon hardware[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We hope you enjoy this update! If you encounter any issues, please reach out to our Support Team at [url="https://support@forwardxp.com!"]support@forwardxp.com[/url] [/p]

notes.title: UPDATE AVAILABLE NOW! 6 new endings + Mac OS support
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/DVnqS4K.png[/img]

[b]Screwdriver?[/b] Check.
[b]Hammer?[/b] Check.
All set for some [b]more wicked enigmas.[/b]

Please note that some of the new endings are somehow connected to the "old" ones. You might find it useful to delete your save and start the game over. 

The soundtrack DLC has been updated and now includes the musics from the new endings.
